title: Ninety Seconds
logline: What happens in the next ninety seconds, and how to spend the ones you have left.
look: Vertical kinetic typography: one bold typeface, eased type with overshoot, per-letter stagger; each idea its own colour field; a heartbeat pulse ties every card together.
narrator: male, young adult, moderate pitch, american accent
Warm, conversational, a smile in the voice
music: Soft piano ostinato on a heartbeat kick; strings lift at "Somewhere"; everything drops to piano for the last line.

narration.text: your heart will beat about a hundred times.
You'll blink around twenty five times.
Nearly four hundred babies will be born.
Earth will carry you two thousand six hundred kilometres around the Sun.
A beam of light will cross twenty seven million kilometres.
Somewhere, a song is being written.
And you're spending yours reading this.
That's fine. Seconds are made to be spent.
Just spend the next ones on someone you love.
